description: This file defines the ArrayStreamBufferWriter struct, which implements IBufferWriter<byte> to facilitate buffering data written to a stream using an internal byte array. It includes methods for advancing the buffer, obtaining memory and span segments, and resizing the buffer as needed.

classes.name: ArrayStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: Implements IBufferWriter<byte> to write data to a Stream with an internal buffer, managing buffer resizing and writing operations.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the position in the buffer by the specified count, writing buffered data to the stream.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> segment for writing, resizing the buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> segment for writing, resizing the buffer if necessary.

methods.name: CheckAndResizeBuffer
methods.description: Resizes the internal buffer to accommodate the specified size hint.
